cases.title: The catalog lists every product with its price

steps.expectedResult: Espresso beans, Filter coffee, Green tea and Ceramic mug are listed
The shop says no products match the search

suites.name: Cart
suites.description: Adding, changing and removing products, and the totals

cases.title: Adding products updates the cart badge and the totals

steps.action: Add Espresso beans twice and a Ceramic mug

steps.expectedResult: The subtotal is €31.80, shipping €4.90 and the total €36.70

cases.title: Changing the quantity updates the totals

steps.action: Add a Filter coffee and open the cart
steps.expectedResult: The cart lists one Filter coffee

steps.action: Set its quantity to 2 and leave the field
steps.expectedResult: The subtotal is €29.00 and the total €33.90

cases.title: Removing the last product empties the cart

steps.action: Add a Ceramic mug and open the cart

steps.expectedResult: The cart says it is empty and the badge shows 0

steps.action: Add three Filter coffees and open the cart
steps.expectedResult: Shipping is free and the total is €43.50
The shop confirms it and the discount is €1.45, the total €17.95
The shop says the code isn't valid and shows no discount

The shop thanks the customer and shows the order number

cases.title: A declined card shows an error and keeps the cart

steps.expectedResult: The shop says the card was declined and the cart keeps its product

defects.title: A discount code can be applied more than once
defects.description: Applying WELCOME10 twice takes 20% off instead of 10%, so "a discount code applies only once" fails when it runs in strict mode.
